# Test: grove add checks out a branch that exists only on a non-origin remote
setup_workspace

cd $WORK
exec git clone testrepo upstream-repo
exec git -C upstream-repo checkout -b feat
cp $WORK/feature.txt upstream-repo/feature.txt
exec git -C upstream-repo add feature.txt
exec git -C upstream-repo commit -m feature

cd workspace/main
exec git -C ../.bare remote add upstream file://$WORK/upstream-repo
exec git -C ../.bare fetch upstream

exec grove add feat
stderr 'Created worktree at .*[/\\]feat'
exists ../feat/feature.txt
exec git -C ../feat rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
stdout '^feat$'
exec git -C ../feat rev-parse --abbrev-ref '@{u}'
stdout '^upstream/feat$'

-- feature.txt --
feature
